about.label: About Baciraro
about.heroDesc: Baciraro connects education, processing, innovation, and digitization in one trusted circular economy value chain — from upstream to downstream.
about.ekosistemTitle: Connecting education, processing, innovation, and digitization.
about.ekosistemDesc: Baciraro is designed to solve environmental problems with an inclusive circular approach, connecting community programs directly to industrial offtakers.
ekosistemItems: Connecting waste management from communities to industry.
Promoting circular economy with measurable approaches.
Providing dashboards and transparent impact tracking.
Supporting CSR, government, and village collaboration.
about.visiDesc: To become the leading circular economy ecosystem that transforms waste into economic, social, and environmental value sustainably for Indonesia and the world.
about.misiDesc: Building an integrated waste management system through education, recycling, community empowerment, creative programs, and digital tracking to create measurable and transparent impact.
about.kolaborasiDesc: We are open to partnership discussions, CSR implementation, and joint environmental programs.

contact.label: Contact Us
contact.heroDesc: Have a collaboration idea, CSR program, or want to learn more about Baciraro? We're ready to listen.
contact.sosmedDesc: Get the latest updates about Baciraro's programs, education, and impact through social media.
contact.formDesc: Fill out the form below and our team will contact you.
contact.ctaDesc: Every collaborative step is an investment in a more circular and sustainable future.

creative.descTitle: Kawasaran is not just a dance, it is the breath of courage.
creative.descBody: Every footstep ignites memory, dignity, and the roots of Minahasa tradition. Within it lies discipline, respect for ancestors, and a strong visual language for cultural presentation.
creative.warisanTitle: A legacy of movement born from courage.
creative.warisanSubtitle: Today it lives on as the face of North Sulawesi culture.

orders.label: ORDERS
orders.slide01Desc: A community of technology developers supporting waste management digitization in the Baciraro ecosystem with innovation, collaboration, and high expertise.
orders.slide03Desc: Digital platforms that regularly monitor circular economy operational data within the Baciraro ecosystem.
orders.slide05Desc: We welcome collaboration with developers, designers, and social entrepreneurs passionate about advancing green technology transformation.

tananyiurlestari.label: TNL Foundation
tananyiurlestari.heroTitle: Building Environmental Awareness from the Community
tananyiurlestari.heroDesc: An environmental education institution focused on community empowerment through sustainable waste management programs and social innovation.
tananyiurlestari.programDesc: Three main programs we run to empower communities in integrated waste management.
tananyiurlestari.ctaDesc: We are open to partnerships, collaborations, and joint action to expand the reach of integrated environmental management programs.

trashrecyclecenter.label: Recycle Center
trashrecyclecenter.heroDesc: A recycling business unit that serves as an offtaker and processor of waste into quality raw materials for the creative and manufacturing industries.
trashrecyclecenter.komoditasDesc: We handle various types of waste with standardized sorting technology and processes.
trashrecyclecenter.ctaDesc: We open collaboration opportunities for industry, government, and communities in professional and value-added waste management.

elmast.label: ELMAST Greenovasi
elmast.heroDesc: Innovative technology for processing organic waste into biogas, compost, and high-quality liquid organic fertilizer for soil conservation and energy independence.
elmast.dokumentasiDesc: Implementation activities of organic waste processing into green energy and sustainable fertilizer with communities.
elmast.produkDesc: Three main products born from ELMAST's environmentally friendly technology facility.
elmast.ctaDesc: We are ready to facilitate the implementation of integrated biogas installations and sustainable biological fertilizer systems at your location.

leadership.label: Leadership
leadership.heroDesc: Baciraro's leadership team dedicated to driving innovation, strengthening collaboration, and creating sustainable impact for communities and the environment.
